findings.title: Missing React `key` prop on `GrafanaRuleListItem` in `rules.map()`
findings.body: In `FilterViewResults`, when replacing `<GrafanaRuleLoader>` with `<GrafanaRuleListItem>`, the `key={key}` prop was removed. Because `GrafanaRuleListItem` is returned directly from `rules.map(...)`, omitting `key` will cause React to emit a missing-key warning and can lead to incorrect component state reconciliation when the filtered rule list updates.

findings.title: Silence notifications action is broken in list view when `rulerRule` is omitted
findings.body: In the new alert list view (`GrafanaRuleListItem`), `RuleActionsButtons` is rendered with only `promRule` and `rule` (`rulerRule`) is `undefined`. `AlertRuleMenu` computes `canSilence` using `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(promRule, ...)` and renders the "Silence notifications" menu item, which calls `setShowSilenceDrawer(true)` on click. However, `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` on line 104 is gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`, which evaluates to `false` when `rule` is `undefined`. Clicking "Silence notifications" in the list view will do nothing because the drawer never renders.

findings.title: Pause and Delete menu items are never rendered when only `promRule` is provided
findings.body: `AlertRuleMenu` was updated to compute `canPause` and `canDelete` from `promRule` via `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` when `rulerRule` is not passed (as in `GrafanaRuleListItem`). However, the JSX conditions for rendering those menu items still require `rulerRule`: line 123 checks `canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` and line 165 checks `canDelete && rulerRule`. Consequently, for Grafana rules in the list view where `rulerRule` is `undefined`, the Pause and Delete actions will never appear in the menu despite permissions being checked.

findings.title: `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` disallows Pause, Restore, ModifyExport, and DeletePermanently on recording rules
findings.body: In `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, `isAlertingRule` (`prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`) is used to gate `ModifyExport`, `Pause`, `Restore`, and `DeletePermanently` (lines 324-330). In `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, those actions are gated on `isGrafanaManagedAlertRule` (`rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)`), which is true for both Grafana alerting rules and Grafana recording rules. Using `alertingRule` instead of ` prometheusRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)` unintentionally disables these abilities for Grafana-managed recording rules.

findings.title: `AlertRuleAction.Silence` ability is marked allowed before folder permissions finish loading
findings.body: In `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, `[AlertRuleAction.Silence]` is set to `[silenceSupported, canSilenceInFolder && isAlertingRule]`. Unlike `useCanSilence` (which returns `[false, false]` when `!rule || folderIsLoading || !folder`), this does not check whether `folder` has loaded or exists, and `useCanSilenceInFolder` returns `true` whenever the user has global `AlertingInstanceCreate` permission even if `folder` is still loading or `undefined` (including when `skipToken` is passed, although `isAlertingRule` happens to be `false` then). If a user has global `AlertingInstanceCreate` but the folder doesn't exist or is still loading, `Silence` will be reported as supported and allowed inconsistently with `useCanSilence`.

findings.title: `returnTo` query parameter lost in rule view link
findings.body: In the removed `GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx`, the rule view link was constructed with `createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`, { returnTo })` using `createReturnTo()`. In the new `GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx`, `{ returnTo }` was dropped (`createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`)`), breaking the "Back to list" navigation from the rule details view when navigating from the rule list or filter view.
